learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to share our toys and sweets equally with our friends so everyone is happy!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If we have 6 candies and 2 friends, we give one by one to each until all candies are finished! Both friends get 3 candies.
We can put 10 pencils into 2 equal boxes. Each box will have exactly 5 pencils. It is so easy and looks very neat!
Sometimes when we share things, we might have one extra thing left that cannot be shared equally. We call it a leftover!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Cookie Sharing Game
fun_activity.instructions: Take 12 small stones or buttons. Try sharing them equally between 3 of your toy bears. How many does each bear get?

quick_recap: ⭐ Sharing means dividing things so everyone gets the same amount.
⭐ We can make equal groups to count and share quickly.
⭐ Sometimes a few things are left over, and that is perfectly okay!
